```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

#---------------------------
# requires the following data:
# b_preds_mort_raster2
#---------------------------

```


```{r map predictions}

#--------------------------------------
# create and save mortality rate maps
# for all treatment arms
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
#--------------------------------------
map_mort_s0 <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_s0,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Overall")

map_mort_tx0_child <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_child,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Control (Placebo + Infant Azithro)")

map_mort_tx1_child <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_child,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Treatment (Child Azithro)")

map_mort_diff_child <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_child
                                       %>% rename(value = diff_mort),
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "ATE (Tx=Child) -- wrong legend label")

map_mort_tx0_alltx <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx0_alltx,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Control (Placebo)")

map_mort_tx1_alltx <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_tx1_alltx,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Treatment (Infant + Child Azithro)")

map_mort_diff_alltx <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_diff_alltx
                                       %>% rename(value = diff_mort),
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "ATE (Tx=Child+Infant) -- wrong legend label")
```

### Preview maps
```{r}

map_mort_tx0_child
map_mort_tx1_child
map_mort_diff_child

map_mort_tx0_alltx
map_mort_tx1_alltx
map_mort_diff_alltx

map_mort_diff_child; map_mort_diff_alltx

```
